name: Spotted Tussock Moth
desc: Spotted Tussock Moth (Lophocampa maculata): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Lophocampa maculata, the Yellow-spotted tussock moth, mottled tiger or spotted halisidota, is a moth of the family Erebidae and the tribe Arctiini, the tiger moths.
